title: The Crab Builds a Hearth
skyStory: Last quarter moon slides into Cancer, sixty-three percent lit and feeling homesick in the coziest way. Cancer is a crab with a house on its back and a soup on the stove. It wants everyone home, socks on, stories told. Saturn agrees. Mars arrives with extra firewood. The half-moon hangs like a bowl turned on its side, catching nothing but stars.

reading: Last quarter means looking back at what you built this month and tidying the workshop. Cancer adds a homely twist: tidy the nest. Clear the table. Fluff a cushion. The cabin wants to feel lived in, not run like a factory.

Around 5:30 pm the darkness comes earlier now. Light a lamp before you need it. Life Path 3 sometimes forgets that home is also an audience: the room, the walls, the chair. Tell the cabin about your day out loud while you sweep. It has been waiting all month to hear.
joel.mission: Light a lamp or candle before sunset and tell your home, out loud, one good thing that happened today.
joel.omen: A window glowing yellow on a dark street. It means someone is waiting for your news; call them.

reading: Cancer lives on the shore, so today the moon is your neighbour. The tide is pulling out a little each evening, and you can feel the season turning toward the long dark. Not sad. Just slower, like the year is taking off its boots.

Last quarter is for releasing. Pick one thing that has been taking up room in your head and set it down on the beach, metaphorically, for the tide to carry away. The [[Six of Swords]] reversed is a crossing nearly done, and you are allowed to leave a bag behind on the old shore.
nancy.mission: Write one thing you are done carrying on a sticky note, crumple it into a tiny ball and sink it in the recycling bin like a pro.
nancy.omen: A crab shell, or a picture of one, in an unexpected place. It means home is wherever you set your shell down.

together.text: Each of you describe your dream rainy-night setup in five specific details: the blanket, the drink, the sound outside, the lamp, the book. Cancer will try to build both and end up making soup.

game.intro: Cancer moon, and the crab is building a hearth. Saturn is warming his hands by your terrible answers.
game.question: What do crabs carry on their backs?
